author: kevinweil
text: Planet’s vision to use space to help life on Earth resonated with me from the instant I met @Will4Planet and @Schingler, and I couldn’t be more excited to join them in their mission.

author: kevinweil
text: We all travel together on spaceship Earth. We have to take care of it, and you can’t manage what you don’t measure.

author: kevinweil
text: Planet’s satellites and services connect to all of this, with a business built around providing data and analytics to help industries as varied as agriculture, finance, and national security.

author: kevinweil
text: I’ve been a math and physics nerd since grad school. I care deeply about climate and sustainability, and am privileged to serve on the board of @nature_org. I joined @CFR_org to learn more about how geopolitics links technology, transparency, security, and sustainability.

author: kevinweil
text: I’m joining Planet because the more I learned about it, the more I found myself unable to think about anything else. Planet is at the intersection of so many of my passions.

author: kevinweil
text: I’m privileged to have worked with an incredibly talented group of teammates who have made all this possible, and now I’m proud to pass the baton to them.

author: kevinweil
text: That’s what we set out to create with Diem, and I still deeply believe in that mission. The digital wallet we’re building at Novi, in combination with other interoperable Diem wallets being built by companies big and small, can change billions of lives for the better.

author: kevinweil
text: Imagine instead if financial infrastructure was built on a regulated, open, interoperable protocol, modeled after the internet—one with low barriers to entry that spurred innovation globally.

author: kevinweil
text: Most people around the world today are not well-served by financial services: payments are slow, expensive, and mediated by a collection of services that don’t work together.

author: kevinweil
text: For the last three years, I’ve given my heart and soul to co-creating Diem (which is now independently led by the @DiemAssociation) and building @Novi at Facebook with  @DavidMarcus and an incredible group of colleagues.

author: kevinweil
text: Their style of intentional, hypothesis-driven product development combined with a never-ending focus on simplifying made Instagram what it is today. I hope one day to be half as good at it as they are.

author: kevinweil
text: As excited as I am, it’s bittersweet to leave Facebook after 5+ years. I joined Instagram in 2016 to lead product, and got to learn from two of the world’s best product thinkers, @kevin and @mikeyk.

author: kevinweil
text: For better and for worse, the Earth is changing at an accelerating rate—and Planet makes that change visible, accessible, and actionable for customers in over 100 countries.

author: kevinweil
text: Personal news! I’m beyond excited to be joining @PlanetLabs in the coming weeks as President, Product & Business. Planet builds and operates a constellation of nearly 200 satellites that images the entire Earth every day.
